description:
Smartwatch 10 Generation 45mm is a big-screen Bluetooth calling smartwatch built for busy days—calls, notifications, and fitness tracking right on your wrist. The large 2.09" LCD TFT display makes text easy to read, so you can glance at caller ID, messages, and workout stats without squinting. With a 10‑meter Bluetooth range, you can keep your phone on the desk or in your bag and still take quick calls from the watch when you’re cooking, commuting, or working.

Track heart rate, blood pressure, and sleep patterns to stay aware of your routine, then switch on multi‑sports modes for walking, running, cycling, and more. Wireless charging keeps it simple—drop it on the charger and go. With a splash‑resistant build, it’s ready for sweat and everyday splashes, making it a practical daily companion for Android and iOS users.

features: 2.09" large LCD TFT display: Big, clear screen for caller ID, messages, and stats—easy reading during work, travel, and workouts.
Bluetooth calling on the wrist: Take quick calls without picking up your phone, ideal for driving stops, kitchens, meetings, and gym sessions.
Wireless charging convenience: Drop-and-charge routine with no fiddly charging pins or cables attached to the watch.
Health tracking for daily awareness: Tracks heart rate, blood pressure, and sleep patterns to help you notice trends (not a medical device).
Multi-sport modes: Supports common activities like walking, running, cycling and more for simple fitness progress tracking.
10-meter Bluetooth range: Stable connectivity when your phone is nearby—on a desk, in a bag, or across the room (range varies by obstacles).
Splash resistant for everyday life: Handles sweat and light splashes for daily wear (avoid swimming and hot showers).
